plainTranslation: The Neptune person can inspire the Mars person's desire and action, but can also blur direction. Attraction may feel dreamy or hard to define. Make agreements concrete, especially around desire, anger, and follow-through.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Refined from approved project relationship source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
summaryShort: Their idealism, vagueness, and dreams sit right on top of your drive, timing, and willingness to act.
summaryDeep: Their idealism, vagueness, and dreams sit right on top of your drive, timing, and willingness to act. This is one of the closest contacts between you, strong and constant, energizing at its best and a lot to hold at its worst. Let the closeness feed you without letting it run you.
